name: marketingskills
description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
one_liner: A free library of ready-made marketing playbooks (for SEO, ad copy, growth, and more) that an AI coding assistant can use to actually do marketing tasks, not just chat about them.
buyer: A solo founder or small agency owner who can't afford a full marketing team but already has an AI coding assistant and wants it to act like a competent marketing hire.
business_use_cases: A solo SaaS founder uses the SEO and CRO skills to have their AI assistant audit and rewrite their landing page without hiring a consultant.
A small agency builds a productized 'AI marketing sprint' offer for clients, using these skills as the operating playbook their AI-assisted team follows.
A marketing tool vendor pays to be the 'recommended integration' inside a specific skill's docs, reaching every user of that skill.

money_ideas.idea: The project already monetizes via a sponsored 'Verified Partners' program inside the skill docs — a native-ad model for tool vendors wanting distribution.
Sell a paid 'AI CMO' service (as the repo's own linked product hints at) that runs these skills autonomously for a client's marketing operations.

steal_this: Package three of these skills (e.g. cold-email, ab-testing, competitors) into a single 'AI marketing starter kit' with a short setup video, and sell it for $49 to solo founders.
